name: Xarwin Caul OLD
description: The Caul is a thin layer of transparent, moist webbing clinging to the manor's exterior surfaces. The stuff feels slippery and unnaturally cold to the touch, and it clings and stretches when a finger or other object used to touch the Caul is pulled away.
disable: DC 32 Occultism (master) or DC 34 Religion (expert) to exorcise the caul
reset: 1 week; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest permanently destroys the haunt.

generalAbilities.name: Burst of Hatrid
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens any door or window into Xarwin Manor, or any creature or object passes through the caul from outside into the manor

Effect The caul immediately bursts like an oily bubble, vanishing in an instant of foul-smelling smoke. A wave of susurration creeps through the area, and all sapient creatures experience a sudden sensation of utter hatred toward birdlife for the span of a single heartbeat. All natural avians within a 300ft Emanation from Xarwin Manor (but not those within the manor or underground) take 15d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
